name: discord-ai-agent
description: Self-hosted Discord AI agent with permission-aware memory, model-led tools, and sandboxed code-update PRs.

scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=critical && npm run docs:check && npm run config:check && npm run scan:release
scripts.verify:db: npm run migrate && npm run test:db
scripts.eval:regressions: npm run eval:export-improvements && npm run eval -- --include-private
